headline: Authority needs a record it can trust.
lede: Ateles governs who may act. Neotoma governs what counts as settled state. The two products meet at the boundary between legitimate action and trustworthy knowledge.

items.title: Ateles answers who was authorized
items.body: Roles, grants, workflows, checkpoints, and attributed execution make delegation governable.

items.title: Neotoma answers what was true
items.body: A durable, correctable, attributable record gives those actions a trustworthy state to act against.
